verses.36:67: وَلَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخۡنَٰهُمۡ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِهِمۡ فَمَا ٱسۡتَطَٰعُواْ مُضِيࣰّ ا وَلَا يَرۡجِعُونَ

meaning: The root "mskh" refers to being transformed into a worse or uglier shape, like humans into apes. It can also describe something deformed, or a person lacking beauty, being weak, or stupid.
